Bash(python3 -c "
import h5py, os

TOTAL_CHANNELS = 76
DATASET_KEY = 'acquisition/ElectricalSeries'

files = [
    'data/medium/medium-ksenija-smoke-1.h5',
    'data/medium/medium-ksenija-smoke-2.h5',
    'data/medium/medium-ksenija-smoke-3.h5',
    'data/medium/smoke_Ani_seed1.h5',
    'data/medium/smoke_Ani_seed3.h5',
    'data/medium/smoke_Ani_seed4.h5',
]

for path in files:
    with h5py.File\(path, 'r'\) as f:
        ds = f[DATASET_KEY]
        flat_len = ds.shape[0]
        ok = flat_len % TOTAL_CHANNELS == 0
        n_frames = flat_len // TOTAL_CHANNELS if ok else 'N/A'
        rate = ds.attrs.get\('rate', None\)
        print\(f'{os.path.basename\(path\):40s}  flat_len={flat_len:>12d}  %76=={flat_len % 76}  n_frames={n_frames}  rate={rate}'\)
")
